info.name: Music Radio
info.summary: Synchronized radio channels built from your own music
info.description:
Music Radio turns your Nextcloud files into radio stations.
Create a **channel**, fill it with audio files from your Files app, and hit play. Everyone tuned in hears the same track at the same moment — the channel owner is the DJ, listeners just listen.
- **Synchronized playback.** A server-authoritative timeline keeps every listener in sync, without needing a streaming server. - **Contributors, not co-DJs.** Share a channel and grant "add tracks" separately from playback control, so people can queue up music without hijacking what is playing. - **Share it your way.** Users, groups, teams, or a public link with an optional password and expiry date.
info.author: Jochen Roth
